# Subnet

A subnet in an existing virtual network, owned by the stack that deploys it.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-readme.sh from the compiled template. Edit the @description and @metadata decorators instead. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Use it | `module m… 'br/platform:modules/network/subnet:v1.0.0' = { … }` |
| Deploys at | resource group scope |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [pContext](#pcontext) | yes | [contextType](#contexttype) |
| [pVnetName](#pvnetname) | yes | string |
| [pName](#pname) | yes | string |
| [pAddressPrefix](#paddressprefix) | yes | string |
| [pNsgId](#pnsgid) | no | string |
| [pServiceEndpoints](#pserviceendpoints) | no | string[] |

### pContext

Where the subnet is deployed.

- Type: [contextType](#contexttype)

### pVnetName

Name of the existing virtual network, in the resource group this module deploys to.

- Type: string
- Example: `vnet-hub-prod-szn-001`

### pName

Purpose of the subnet, used in its name. Names Azure reserves for its own services are kept as they are.

- Type: string
- Example: `app`

### pAddressPrefix

Address range of the subnet, inside the address space of the virtual network.

- Type: string
- Example: `10.10.16.0/26`

### pNsgId

Resource ID of the network security group to attach. Without it, the subnet has none.

- Type: string

### pServiceEndpoints

Service endpoints to enable on the subnet.

- Type: string[]
- Default: `[]`
- Example: `["Microsoft.Storage"]`

## Types

### contextType

Where a resource is deployed. Every module takes it as pContext.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| environment | yes | [environmentType](#environmenttype) | Environment short name, used in every resource name. |
| location | yes | [regionType](#regiontype) | Azure region of the resources. |
| tags | no | object | Tags added to every resource. Example: `{"workload":"sample-app","owner":"platform-team"}` |

### environmentType

Environment short name. Each environment has its own management group hierarchy and subscriptions.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `dev`, `prod`

### regionType

Azure regions this platform deploys to. Each one has a short code in regionCode().

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `switzerlandnorth`, `switzerlandwest`, `westeurope`

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| oName | string | Name of the subnet. |
| oId | string | Resource ID of the subnet. |
